data.name: QuerySelectAll
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[POHeaderID], [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[CompanyID], [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[PeriodID], [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[Status], [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[TypeCode], SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[DocumentNumber], [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[DocumentDate], ISNULL([AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[VendorID], '-1') as [VendorID], [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerName as [SupplierName], [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[AcceptanceDueDate], [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[StatusCode] , Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName FROM [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader] INNER JOIN [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail] pod ON pod.[POHeaderID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[POHeaderID] And [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].status = 1 AND pod.[Status] = 1 AND pod.[CompanyID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND pod.[PeriodID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[PeriodID] INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].TypeCode LEFT JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [AR_SET_Customer].[Customerid] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[VendorID] and [AR_SET_Customer].[Status] = 1 --AND [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[PeriodID] left join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].DocumentNumber and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].TypeCode and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = pod.PODetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = pod.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = pod.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.status =1
left join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].POHeaderID or AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID= [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].POHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID= [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID is null and AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID is null

data.name: QuerywithPaging
data.value:
select *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[POHeaderID] desc) AS 'Row' from ( SELECT DISTINCT poh.[POHeaderID], poh.[CompanyID], poh.[PeriodID], poh.[Status], poh.[TypeCode], SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, poh.[DocumentNumber], poh.[DocumentDate], ISNULL(poh.[VendorID], '-1') as [VendorID], [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerName as [SupplierName], poh.[AcceptanceDueDate], SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedByValue , poh.[StatusCode], Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName FROM [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader] poh INNER JOIN [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail] pod ON pod.[POHeaderID] = poh.[POHeaderID] And poh.status = 1 and pod.[Status] = 1 AND pod.[CompanyID] = poh.[CompanyID] AND pod.[PeriodID] = poh.[PeriodID] INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = poh.TypeCode LEFT JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [AR_SET_Customer].[Customerid] = poh.[VendorID] and [AR_SET_Customer].[Status] = 1 --AND [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] = poh.[CompanyID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] = poh.[PeriodID] left join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = poh.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = poh.DocumentNumber and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = poh.TypeCode and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = pod.PODetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = pod.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = pod.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.status =1
left join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID = poh.POHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID= poh.POHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID= poh.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on poh.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
left JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status =1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = poh.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = poh.DocumentNumber AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = (SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND PeriodID = poh.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = poh.TypeCode AND DocumentNo = poh.DocumentNumber
) where INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID is null and AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID is null ) [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader]

data.name: Query_DocumenttypesforPOStatus
data.value: select MAX (DocumentType)PO_Type , DocumentTypeID from dbo.AP_PurchaseOrderHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.typecode and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID group by documenttype ,DocumentTypeID

data.name: Query_ImportDocumentLooKup
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AcceptanceDueDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AcceptanceRequiredFlag, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AmountLimit, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ApprovalRequiredFlag, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ApprovedDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ApprovedFlag, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AuthorizationStatusCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BillToLocationID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BlanketTotalAmount, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CancelFlag, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ClosedCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ClosedDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Comments, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CurrencyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.EndDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FOBCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FreightTermsCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FromHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FromTypeCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FrozenFlag, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.MinReleaseAmount, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.NoteToReceiver, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.NoteToVendor, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PrintCount, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PrintedDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.QuoteType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Rate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RateType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ReplyDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ReplyMethod, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RevisedDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RevisionNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RFQClosedDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipToLocationID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipViaCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StartDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TermsID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TotalAmount, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.UserHoldFlag, isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorQuoteNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreatedBy, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreatedByValue, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.UpdatedBy, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.UpdateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.UpdatedByValue, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.IsActive, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate, SET_Location.LocationName, SET_Term.Description AS 'TermDescription', SET_Currency.CurrencyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS POTypeName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PODueDate ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber as BLNo,AP_SaleContractHeader.TotalContainers as NoOfContainers ,AP_SaleContractHeader.ContractNo FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipToLocationID INNER JOIN AP_SaleContractHeader ON AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SaleContractID LEFT JOIN SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TermsID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_StocktransactionDetail ON INV_StocktransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID --AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.SourceCode = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber LEFT JOIN INV_StocktransactionHeader ON INV_StocktransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StocktransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StocktransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StocktransactionHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail On AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID Left Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID {0} WHERE (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = @StatusCode OR @StatusCode IS NULL) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = @SupplierID OR @SupplierID IS NULL) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = @POHeaderID OR @POHeaderID IS NULL) AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 And IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.IsInvoiceAdjusted, 0) = 0

data.name: Query_SelectAllSaleContract_Searching
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID, AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID, AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID, AP_SaleContractHeader.Status, AP_SaleContractHeader.TypeCode, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentNumber, AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentDate, ISNULL(AP_SaleContractHeader.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, AP_SaleContractHeader.AcceptanceDueDate, AP_SaleContractHeader.StatusCode FROM AP_SaleContractHeader INNER JOIN AP_SaleContractDetail pod ON pod.SaleContractID = AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID And AP_SaleContractHeader.status = 1 AND pod.Status = 1 AND pod.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID AND pod.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_SaleContractHeader.TypeCode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.Customerid = AP_SaleContractHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID

data.name: Query_SelectAll_ForApproveDetail
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate, ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AcceptanceDueDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedByvalue, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail pod ON pod.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 AND pod.Status = 1 AND pod.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND pod.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.Customerid = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT poh.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh WHERE poh.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND poh.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND poh.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT poh.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh WHERE poh.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND poh.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND poh.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = @POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = @DocumentTypeID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = @DocumentNo

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate, ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AcceptanceDueDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail pod ON pod.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 AND pod.Status = 1 AND pod.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND pod.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.Customerid = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_ForApprove
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate, ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AcceptanceDueDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedByvalue, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail pod ON pod.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 AND pod.Status = 1 AND pod.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND pod.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.Customerid = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status =1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = (SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND DocumentNo = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber) INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT poh.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh WHERE poh.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND poh.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND poh.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT poh.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh WHERE poh.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND poh.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND poh.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_WithPaging
data.value:
select *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID desc) AS 'Row' from ( SELECT DISTINCT poh.POHeaderID, poh.CompanyID, poh.PeriodID, poh.Status, poh.TypeCode as DocumentTypeID , SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, poh.DocumentNumber as DocumentNo, poh.DocumentDate, ISNULL(poh.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, poh.AcceptanceDueDate, poh.CreatedByValue, poh.CreateDate,poh.UpdateDate,poh.UpdatedByValue, poh.StatusCode,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID,AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentNumber as ContractNo,poh.BLNumber FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail pod ON pod.POHeaderID = poh.POHeaderID And poh.status = 1 and pod.Status = 1 AND pod.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND pod.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on poh.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = poh.TypeCode inner join ApplicationMenu on ApplicationMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID --and ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/ALImdad/Transaction/DocumentIN_frm.aspx' and ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/ALImdad/Transaction/ImportDocument_frm.aspx' LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.Customerid = poh.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID left JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = poh.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = poh.DocumentNumber AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND PeriodID = poh.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = poh.TypeCode AND DocumentNo = poh.DocumentNumber )
LEFT join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = poh.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = poh.DocumentNumber
inner join AP_SaleContractHeader on AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID = poh.SaleContractID and AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID and AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID --and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID
) AP_PurchaseOrderHeader

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_WithPaging_ForApprove
data.value:
SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber desc) AS 'Row' FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT poh_Outer.POHeaderID, poh_Outer.CompanyID, poh_Outer.PeriodID, poh_Outer.Status, poh_Outer.TypeCode, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, poh_Outer.DocumentNumber, poh_Outer.DocumentDate, ISNULL(poh_Outer.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, poh_Outer.AcceptanceDueDate, poh_Outer.StatusCode, poh_Outer.CreatedByvalue ,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,Requisition.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as DRequisitionNo ,SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedByValue AS lastApproval ,SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedBy AS LastApprovalID ,set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalUserID FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh_Outer INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail pod ON pod.POHeaderID = poh_Outer.POHeaderID And poh_Outer.status = 1 AND pod.Status = 1 AND pod.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND pod.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND pod.FiscalID = poh_Outer.FiscalID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on poh_Outer.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = poh_Outer.TypeCode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.Customerid = poh_Outer.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID
left JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = poh_Outer.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = poh_Outer.DocumentNumber AND SET_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = poh_Outer.FiscalID AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = poh_Outer.TypeCode AND DocumentNo = poh_Outer.DocumentNumber AND FiscalID = poh_Outer.FiscalID )
left join Set_documentPendingApprove on Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID and Set_documentPendingApprove.companyID = SET_DocumentApprove.companyID and Set_documentPendingApprove.PeriodID = SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID
INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = poh_Outer.TypeCode OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), poh_Outer.DocumentDate, 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), poh_Outer.DocumentDate, 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ph.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ph WHERE ph.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND ph.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND ph.POHeaderID = poh_Outer.POHeaderID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ph.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ph WHERE ph.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND ph.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND ph.POHeaderID= poh_Outer.POHeaderID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1
INNER JOIN aspnet_UsersInRoles On aspnet_UsersInRoles.UserID = poh_Outer.CreatedBy And (aspnet_UsersInRoles.RoleID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleID or SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleID is null)
--new Working (Roles aginst Approver) inner join ApplicationMenu on ApplicationMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID inner join MenusInRoles on MenusInRoles.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID inner join aspnet_Roles on aspnet_Roles.RoleId = MenusInRoles.RoleId
LEFT JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID = poh_Outer.FiscalID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.DocumentNo = poh_Outer.VendorQuoteNumber
LEFT JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.FiscalID = PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_QuotationHeader.EnquiryHeaderID
LEFT JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = poh_Outer.[StockRequisitionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = poh_Outer.[CompanyID] --AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] = poh.[FiscalID] comment becous not showing Req no prv fiscal year AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = poh_Outer.[PeriodID]
--left JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] as Requisition ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = Requisition.CompanyID --AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = Requisition.PeriodID --AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.FiscalID = Requisition.FiscalID --AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.FK_INV_StockTransactionID = Requisition.StockTransactionID
left join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition as Requisition on Requisition.POHeaderID = pod.POHeaderID and Requisition.PODetailID = pod.PODetailID and Requisition.CompanyID = pod.CompanyID and Requisition.PeriodID = pod.PeriodID and Requisition.FiscalID = pod.FiscalID --and Requisition.status =1
) AP_PurchaseOrderHeader

EnquiryNo, PUR_QuotationHeader.EnquiryHeaderID, [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[StockRequisitionID], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] ,[AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].LOCID, [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].LOCName ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DiscountForAllItems,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.OnNetAmount ,Set_IncoTerm.Description,Subjects,POReviseDate,POReviseReason,BankDetails,TermsAndConditions,[AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].DemandType,[AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].SeasonType
FROM [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader] LEFT JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.DocumentNo = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].VendorQuoteNumber AND PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].FiscalID LEFT JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_QuotationHeader.EnquiryHeaderID LEFT JOIN [SET_Location] ON [SET_Location].[LocationID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[ShipToLocationID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Location] AS BilledLocation ON BilledLocation.[LocationID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[BillToLocationID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Term] ON [SET_Term].[TermID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[TermsID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Currency] ON [SET_Currency].[CurrencyID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[CurrencyID] LEFT JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[VendorID] --AND [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[PeriodID] LEFT JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[StockRequisitionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[PeriodID]
left Join Set_IncoTerm on Set_IncoTerm.IncoTermID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].IncoTermID
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].TypeCode WHERE ([AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[StatusCode] = @StatusCode OR @StatusCode IS NULL) AND ([AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[VendorID] = @SupplierID OR @SupplierID IS NULL) AND ([AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[POHeaderID] = @POHeaderID OR @POHeaderID IS NULL) AND [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[PeriodID] in ( @PeriodID ) AND [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[Status] = 1

data.name: Query_Select_By_PrimaryKey_WithOtherTablesForAdvance_AndWithoutClosedCode
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS POTypeName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StocktransactionDetail ON INV_StocktransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_StocktransactionHeader ON INV_StocktransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StocktransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StocktransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StocktransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StocktransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StocktransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StocktransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID Where IsNull( ( Select Sum(Ap_paymentHeader.Amount) from Ap_paymentHeader Where Ap_paymentHeader.status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = Ap_paymentHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = Ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = Ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID And IsNull(Ap_paymentHeader.ReversalDate, 0) = 0 And Ap_paymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL ), 0) < (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TotalAmount * AdvanceAmountPercentage) / 100 AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = @StatusCode OR @StatusCode IS NULL) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = @SupplierID OR @SupplierID IS NULL) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = @POHeaderID OR @POHeaderID IS NULL) AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND isnull(AdvanceAmountPercentage,0) > 0

AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PODueDate ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DiscountForAllItems,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.OnNetAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.SourceCode = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber LEFT JOIN INV_StocktransactionHeader ON INV_StocktransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StocktransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StocktransactionHeader.CompanyID AND = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID Left Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 {0} WHERE (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = @StatusCode OR @StatusCode IS NULL) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = @SupplierID OR @SupplierID IS NULL) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = @POHeaderID OR @POHeaderID IS NULL) AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {1} AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 And IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.IsInvoiceAdjusted, 0) = 0

data.name: query_Select_DataByKey_ForApprove
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator ,SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAmountID ,SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT poh.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh WHERE poh.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND poh.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND poh.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT poh.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh WHERE poh.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND poh.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND poh.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 Left join UsersInRoles on UsersInRoles.RoleId = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleId and UsersInRoles.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID
INNER JOIN aspnet_UsersInRoles On aspnet_UsersInRoles.UserID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreatedBy And (aspnet_UsersInRoles.RoleID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleID or SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleID is null) And (aspnet_UsersInRoles.UserId = SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserId or SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserId is null)
--new Working (Roles aginst Approver) inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode inner join ApplicationMenu on ApplicationMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID inner join MenusInRoles on MenusInRoles.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID inner join aspnet_Roles on aspnet_Roles.RoleId = MenusInRoles.RoleId
WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = @POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = @DocumentTypeID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = @DocumentNo and aspnet_UsersInRoles.RoleId = aspnet_Roles.RoleId

LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Contractor ON Contractor.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ContractorID AND Contractor.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND Contractor.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND Contractor.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Location On Set_Location.LocationID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BillToLocationID And Set_Location.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID --INV_Item.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AND INV_Item.Status = 1 WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = @POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1

AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PODueDate ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber as BLNO,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.NoofContainers as NoOfContainers ,AP_SaleContractHeader.ContractNo FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipToLocationID INNER JOIN AP_SaleContractHeader ON AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SourceCode,SourceDocumentTypeID,SourceHeaderID,SourceLineID,INV_StocktransactionHeader.CompanyID,INV_StocktransactionHeader.PeriodID,Sum(TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity from INV_StocktransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StocktransactionHeader ON INV_StocktransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StocktransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StocktransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StocktransactionHeader.PeriodID
Where INV_StocktransactionDetail.Status=1 group by SourceCode,SourceDocumentTypeID,SourceHeaderID,SourceLineID,INV_StocktransactionHeader.CompanyID,INV_StocktransactionHeader.PeriodID ) as StockTransaction ON StockTransaction.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID AND StockTransaction.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID AND StockTransaction.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID AND StockTransaction.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID AND StockTransaction.SourceDocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND StockTransaction.SourceCode = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber Left Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID {0} WHERE (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = @StatusCode OR @StatusCode IS NULL) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = @SupplierID OR @SupplierID IS NULL) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = @POHeaderID OR @POHeaderID IS NULL) AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity > ISNULL(StockTransaction.TransactionQuantity,0) {1} AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 And IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.IsInvoiceAdjusted, 0) = 0 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode in (Select DocumenttypeID from SET_DocumentType where DocumentType like '%Import%doc%') ) as fintab

data.name: Query_ImportContractDetails
data.value:
select AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentNumber as ContractNo, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as ContractType, Cast(AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentDate as Date) as ContractDate, AR_SET_CustomerContract.CustomerName as CustomerNameContract, AP_SaleContractHeader.TotalAmount as ContractAmountFC, SET_CurrencyContract.CurrencyName as CurrencyNameContract,
FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo, Cast(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate as Date) as LCDate, cast(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.RetirementDate as Date) as RetirementDate, isnull(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.TotalAmount,0) as LCAmountFC, isnull(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Rate,0) as ConversionRateLC, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.AccountNo , SET_Currency.CurrencyName as CurrencyNameLC, isnull(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.TotalAmount,0) * isnull(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Rate,0) as LCAmountPKR,
AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as ImportDocNumber, Cast(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate as Date) as ImportDocDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber, isnull((AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AmountIndollar * AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Rate),0) as MaterialAndLogistics, Cast(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipmentDate as Date) as ShipmentDate, Cast(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ETA as Date) as ETA, Cast(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ETD as Date) as ETD, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.NoofContainers, Isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AmountIndollar,0) as ImportAmountFC, Isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Rate,0) as ImportConversionRate, Isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AmountIndollar,0) * Isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Rate,0) as ImportAmountPkr,
Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.DocumentNo as DocNoGD, Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.Gl_Number as GDNumber, Cast(Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CreateDate as Date) as DocDateGD, Cast(Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.IGMDate as Date) as IGMDate, Cast(Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.OutOfChargeDate as Date) as OutOfChargeDate, isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.ExchangeRatePercent,0) as ConversionRateGD, isnull(GD.SalesTax,0) as SalesTaxGD, isnull(GD.AdditionalSalesTax,0) as AdditionalSalesTax, isnull(GD.IncomeTax,0) as IncomeTax, isnull(GD.GDAssessValueDollar,0) as DutiesAndTaxes,
IMP_CustomClearing.CustomClearingID as CCNumber, Cast(IMP_CustomClearing.CCDate as Date) as CCDate, AR_SET_CustomerCC.CustomerName as CCCustomerName, isnull(IMP_CustomClearing.TotalInvoiceAmount,0) as ClearingCharges,
Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.ContainerTransportationID as DocNumberTransportation, Cast(Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.CreateDate as Date) as DocDateTransportation, AR_SET_CustomerTransportation.CustomerName as TransportationCustomerName, isnull(Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.TotalTransAmount,0) as TransportationAmount,
DirectLcExpense_Header.CustomClearingID as DocNumberLC, Cast(DirectLcExpense_Header.CCDate as Date) as DocDateLC, AR_SET_CustomerLCExpense.CustomerName as CustomerNameLCExpense, isnull(DirectLcExpense_Header.TotalAmount,0) as LCDirectExpense,
tb_grn.DocumentNo as DocNumberGRN, tb_grn.DocumentDate as DocDateGRN, tb_grn.Amount as GRNImportCost
from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader left join AP_SaleContractHeader on AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SaleContractID and AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_SaleContractHeader.Status = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status and AP_SaleContractHeader.StatusCode = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode
left join Fabric_ImportCostingHeader on Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.BL_Number = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
left join FA_LetterOfCreditHeader on FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.SaleContractID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SaleContractID and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
left join SET_Currency on SET_Currency.CurrencyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CurrencyID
--left join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.BankID left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.BankID
Left Join AR_SET_Bank ON AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID
Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_SaleContractHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
--left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID
left join IMP_CustomClearing on IMP_CustomClearing.BINumber = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and IMP_CustomClearing.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and IMP_CustomClearing.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_Customer as AR_SET_CustomerCC on AR_SET_CustomerCC.CustomerID = IMP_CustomClearing.ClearingAgentID
left join Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading on Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.BINo = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_Customer as AR_SET_CustomerTransportation on AR_SET_CustomerTransportation.CustomerID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.TransporterID
left join DirectLcExpense_Header on DirectLcExpense_Header.CostingID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and DirectLcExpense_Header.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and DirectLcExpense_Header.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_Customer as AR_SET_CustomerLCExpense on AR_SET_CustomerLCExpense.CustomerID = DirectLcExpense_Header.ClearingAgentID
left join AR_SET_Customer as AR_SET_CustomerContract on AR_SET_CustomerContract.CustomerID = AP_SaleContractHeader.VendorID left join SET_Currency as SET_CurrencyContract on SET_CurrencyContract.CurrencyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CurrencyID
left join (Select distinct SUM(SalesTax) as SalesTax,SUM(AdditionalSalesTax) as AdditionalSalesTax,SUM(IncomeTax) as IncomeTax,SUM(GDAssessValueDollar) as GDAssessValueDollar,FIH.CostingID,FIH.CompanyID,FIH.PeriodID from Fabric_ImportCostingHeader FIH inner join Fabric_ImportCostingDetail on Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingID = FIH.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CompanyID = FIH.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PeriodID = FIH.PeriodID LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = FIH.StockTransactionID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = FIH.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = FIH.PeriodID LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingDetailID inner join INV_ITem on INV_ITem.ItemID = Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ITemID inner join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_ITem.ItemTypeID inner join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_ITem.ItemCatalogGroupID left join INV_ItemDetails on INV_ItemDetails.ITemID = INV_ITem.ItemID left join SET_Composition on SET_Composition.CompositionName = INV_ItemDetails.Composition and SET_Composition.Status = 1 where FIH.Status = 1 and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.Status = 1 group by FIH.CostingID,FIH.CompanyID,FIH.PeriodID ) GD on GD.CompanyID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and GD.PeriodID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID and GD.CostingID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID
left join (Select SUM(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount)Amount , SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.BL,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID,SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.PeriodID from SET_WeightAssessmentHeader inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.PeriodID
inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit'
where SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1
group by SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.BL,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID,SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.PeriodID
) tb_grn on tb_grn.BL = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and tb_grn.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and tb_grn.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentNumber is not null {0} order by AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentNumber asc

data.name: Query_ShipmentCosting
data.value:
--Declare @BLNumber varchar(50) = 'MEDUUK703558' --Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FiscalID int = 1
select AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber, AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentNumber as ContractNo, Cast(AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentDate as Date) as ContractDate, Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.Gl_Number as GDNumber, Cast(Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CreateDate as Date) as ShipmentDate, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo, Cast(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate as Date) as LCDate, isnull(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.TotalAmount,0) as LCAMountFC, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.BankName, isnull(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Charges,0) as LCCharges, isnull((Select SUM(isnull(Amount,0)) * -1 from IMP_CClearingDetail left Join Fabrics_SET_ExpenseType on Fabrics_SET_ExpenseType.ExpenseTypeID=IMP_CClearingDetail.ExpenseTypeID and Fabrics_SET_ExpenseType.Status = 1 where IMP_CClearingDetail.Status = 1 and ExpenseType like '%DEMURRAGE%' and IMP_CClearingDetail.CCHeaderID = IMP_CustomClearing.CustomClearingID ),0) LessPortDemurragesAmount, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.AccountNo , cast(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.RetirementDate as Date) as RetirementDate,
isnull(Convert(decimal(18,2),PODetail.NetAmount),0) as MaterialAndLogistics, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as MaterialAndLogisticsDocumentNumber,
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as MaterialAndLogisticCustomerName,
isnull(IMP_CustomClearing.TotalGDAmount,0) as DutiesAndTaxes,
(select top 1 GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo from GL_TransactionHeader inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID inner join set_documentType on set_documentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and set_documentType.Status = 1
where SourceHeaderID = IMP_CustomClearing.CustomClearingID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and set_documentType.DocumentType like 'Custom Clearing' and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1) as DutiesAndTaxesDocumentNumber,
isnull(IMP_CustomClearing.TotalAmount,0) as CustomClearingAmount,
AR_SET_CustomerCC.CustomerName as CCCustomerName,
isnull(Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.TotalTransAmount,0) as TransportationAmount ,Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.ContainerTransportationID as TransportationAmountDocumentNo
,AR_SET_CustomerTransportation.CustomerName as TransportationCustomerName
,isnull(DirectLcExpense_Header.TotalAmount,0) as LCDirectExpense ,DirectLcExpense_Header.CustomClearingID as LCDirectExpenseDocumentNo
,AR_SET_CustomerLCExpense.CustomerName as CustomerNameLCExpense ,SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.IncomeTax,0)) * -1 IncomeTax ,SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.SalesTax,0)) * -1 SalesTax ,SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.AdditionalSalesTax,0)) * -1 AdditionalTax ,(ISNULL(IMP_CustomClearing.GSTAmount,0)) * -1 CustomClearingGST ,ISNUll(Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.GSTAmount,0) * -1 TransportTax ,ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ServiceCharges,0) as ServiceCharges
from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader inner join AP_SaleContractHeader on AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SaleContractID and AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_SaleContractHeader.Status = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status and AP_SaleContractHeader.StatusCode = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode
left join ( select Sum(NetAmount) as NetAmount,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 group by AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID ) PODetail on PODetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and PODetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and PODetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
left join Fabric_ImportCostingHeader on Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.BL_Number = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
left join Fabric_ImportCostingDetail on Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CompanyID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PeriodID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID

data.name: Query_POGRNBalanceReport
data.value:
select CustomerName, case when max(GLType) = 'Debit' then abs(sum(GLBalance)) * -1 else abs(sum(GLBalance)) end as GLBalance,max(GLType) as GLType,sum(POBalance) as POBalance ,sum(GRNBalance) as GRNBalance from (
select tab.CustomerName ,(sum(debit) - sum(credit)) as GLBalance, case when (sum(debit) - sum(credit)) < 0 then 'Credit' else 'Debit' end as GLType,0 as POBalance,0 as GRNBalance from (
---------- Sales Invoice Header ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Description As Comments, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit'
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalID is null and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0 --and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between null and null) OR (null is null) OR (null is null)) AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @Todate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Description, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
Union All ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null --and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between null and null) OR (null is null) OR (null is null)) AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @Todate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
union all ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO From Sal_InvoiceHeader
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode
inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode Where Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = 1 And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) < @Todate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.DocumentTypeID,FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
union all ---------- Purchase Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode as CustomerAccountCode, Case When AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO From AR_InvoiceHeader
Inner Join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail On AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode
inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = 1 And IsNull(AR_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) < @Todate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null --and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between null and null) OR (null is null) OR (null is null)) AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @Todate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo, FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO union all ---------- Sales Receipt Customer Detail - Opening ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate, CreateDate,CompanyID,FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select DISTINCT AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail On AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID
