left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CostCentreID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null AND convert(date,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @Todate and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between null and null) OR (null is null) OR (null is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%OPENING%' and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, CreateDate,CompanyID,FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO

FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS PO_NO

JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom .CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID --and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between @fromDate and @Todate and isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ClosedCode,0) <> 1 and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) as TAB Where TAB.RcvQty < TAB.Quantity group by CustomerName
union all
-- GRN balance
select Supplier as CustomerName,0 as GLBalance,'' as GLType,0 as POBalance,sum(GRN_Amount) as GRNBalance from (
select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier, '(' + INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode + ') ' + INV_Item.Description as Item, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as GRN_No, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity as PO_Quantity, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity) as GRN_Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as ApprovedGRN_Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity as RejectedGRN_Quantity, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as RemainingQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as Rate, round(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 1) as PO_Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount as GRN_Amount, 0 as BalanceAmount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0 as QuantityInvoiced,0 as AmountPaid, CONVERT(varchar(20), AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 105) as InvoiceDate, 0 as InvoiceNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID ANd INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.status = 1 INNER join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 inner join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1 inner join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].MenuID LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 LEFT Join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status =1
left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
where INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @fromDate and @Todate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- (only approved GRN appeared) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 --and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ClosedCode > 2 --(coz Inprocess Invoice not showing) and [ApplicationMenu].MenuPath like '%/Stock_frm.aspx'
and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , '(' + INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode + ') ' + INV_Item.Description , AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo , AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity , Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity) , INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity , AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost , round(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 1) , INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount , round((AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) - INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, 3), INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, CONVERT(varchar(20), AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 105) , AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID,AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID,AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType ,AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID,AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID
having isnull(( select sum(indtl.QuantityInvoiced) from AR_InvoiceHeader invHdr inner join AR_InvoiceDetail indtl on indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = invHdr.InvoiceID and indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = invHdr.InvoiceID and indtl.CompanyID = invHdr.CompanyID and indtl.PeriodID = invHdr.PeriodID and indtl.Status = 1 where indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and indtl.InvoiceDetailID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and indtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and indtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID ),0 ) <> INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity
)tab group by Supplier
)as fintab
group by CustomerName

data.name: Query_CostingOfImportedMaterials
data.value:
--Declare @CompanyID int = 2 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2022-05-30 00:00:00:000'
select Description,UOMName,sum(Quantity) as Quantity,sum(RecievedQty) as RecievedQty,sum(ItemCost) as ItemCost,sum(PerUnitCost)as PerUnitCost,sum(IntransitQty) as IntransitQty,ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order by Description asc) as 'Row' from ( select distinct AP_SaleContractDetail.SaleContractID, Upper(INV_Item.Description) as Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,Convert(decimal(18,2),Round((AP_SaleContractDetail.Quantity),2)) as Quantity ,Convert(decimal(18,2),sum(Round(Isnull((SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity),0),2))) as RecievedQty , Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost),0),2)) as ItemCost, Convert(decimal(18,2),(case when Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity),0),2)) > 0 then Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost),0),2)) / Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity),0),2)) else 0 end )) as PerUnitCost , Convert(decimal(18,2),Round((AP_SaleContractDetail.Quantity) - Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity),0),2)) as IntransitQty ,ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order by INV_Item.Description asc) as 'Row' from AP_SaleContractHeader
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_SaleContractHeader.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
left join AP_SaleContractDetail on AP_SaleContractDetail.SaleContractID = AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID and AP_SaleContractDetail.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID and AP_SaleContractDetail.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID and AP_SaleContractDetail.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
left join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = AP_SaleContractDetail.Status
left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemUOMID and SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SaleContractID = AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
left join SET_WeightAssessmentHeader on SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.BL = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.Status = 1 and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.StatusCode =1
left join SET_WeightSubDetail on SET_WeightSubDetail.WeightAssessmentID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.WeightAssessmentID and SET_WeightSubDetail.CompanyID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID and SET_WeightSubDetail.Status = 1 and SET_WeightSubDetail.ItemID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID
left join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.BLNo = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
left join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status =1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode
AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID=SET_WeightSubDetail.SourceHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID=SET_WeightSubDetail.SourceDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID=SET_WeightSubDetail.CompanyID
where SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Purchase Contract - Raw Material' and AP_SaleContractHeader.Status = 1 and AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate {0} group by INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,AP_SaleContractDetail.SaleContractID,AP_SaleContractDetail.Quantity ) as fintab group by Description,UOMName
--select Upper(INV_Item.Description) as Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName --,Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(SUM(AP_SaleContractDetail.Quantity),2)) as Quantity --,Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity),0),2)) as RecievedQty --,Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost),0),2)) as ItemCost --, --Convert(decimal(18,2),(case when Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity),0),2)) > 0 then --Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost),0),2)) / Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity),0),2)) --else 0 end )) --as PerUnitCost --,Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(SUM(AP_SaleContractDetail.Quantity) - Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity),0),2)) as IntransitQty --,ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order by INV_Item.Description asc) as 'Row' --from AP_SaleContractHeader
--inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_SaleContractHeader.TypeCode --and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID --and SET_DocumentType.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
--left join AP_SaleContractDetail on AP_SaleContractDetail.SaleContractID = AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID --and AP_SaleContractDetail.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID --and AP_SaleContractDetail.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID --and AP_SaleContractDetail.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
--left join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.Status = AP_SaleContractDetail.Status
--left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemUOMID --and SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
--left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SaleContractID = AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID --and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID --and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID --and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
--left join SET_WeightAssessmentHeader on SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.BL = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber --and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID --and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID --and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
--left join SET_WeightSubDetail on SET_WeightSubDetail.WeightAssessmentID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.WeightAssessmentID --and SET_WeightSubDetail.CompanyID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID --and SET_WeightSubDetail.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status --and SET_WeightSubDetail.ItemID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID
--left join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.BLNo = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
--left join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID --and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID --and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status --and INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID
--where SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Purchase Contract - Raw Material' and AP_SaleContractHeader.Status = 1 and AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID --and AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate --group by INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName
--select AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONumber,SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.DocumentDate as ReceiveDate,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription -- ,AR_SET_Customer .CustomerName,SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice as Rate -- ,DirectLcExpense_Header.TotalAmount as LCCharges -- ,0 as insur -- ,0 as DocsAmount -- ,isnull(IMP_CustomClearing.TotalGDAmount,0) as DutiesAndTaxes -- ,isnull(Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.TotalTransAmount,0) as TransportationAmount -- ,0 as TCost -- ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as PerUnitCost
-- from SET_WeightAssessmentHeader -- inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.ImportDocumentID -- and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID -- and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.PeriodID
-- inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID -- and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID -- and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID -- and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1

left join SET_WeightAssessmentHeader on SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.BL = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.Status = 1 and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.StatusCode =1
left join SET_WeightSubDetail on SET_WeightSubDetail.WeightAssessmentID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.WeightAssessmentID and SET_WeightSubDetail.CompanyID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID and SET_WeightSubDetail.Status = 1 and SET_WeightSubDetail.ItemID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID
left join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.BLNo = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
left join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status =1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode
AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID=SET_WeightSubDetail.SourceHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID=SET_WeightSubDetail.SourceDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID=SET_WeightSubDetail.CompanyID
where SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Purchase Contract - Raw Material' and AP_SaleContractHeader.Status = 1 and AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate group by INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,AP_SaleContractDetail.SaleContractID,AP_SaleContractDetail.Quantity ) as fintab group by Description,UOMName

data.name: Query_ForImportDetail_Report
data.value:
select *,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID asc) AS 'Row' from (
SELECT DISTINCT poh.POHeaderID, poh.CompanyID, poh.PeriodID, poh.Status, poh.TypeCode as DocumentTypeID , SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, poh.DocumentNumber as DocumentNo, poh.DocumentDate as GLDate, poh.ShipmentDate, poh.BLNumber, poh.Rate as ConversionRate, poh.NoofContainers, poh.ETA as ETADate ,poh.ETD as ETDDate, poh.AmountIndollar,poh.CurrencyID, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, ISNULL(poh.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier, poh.AcceptanceDueDate, poh.CreateDate, Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail pod ON pod.POHeaderID = poh.POHeaderID And poh.status = 1 and pod.Status = 1 AND pod.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND pod.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on poh.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = poh.TypeCode
inner join ApplicationMenu on ApplicationMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID and ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/ALImdad/Transaction/ImportDocument_frm.aspx' LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.Customerid = poh.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID left JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = poh.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = poh.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = poh.DocumentNumber AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = poh.CompanyID AND PeriodID = poh.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = poh.TypeCode AND DocumentNo = poh.DocumentNumber )
left join SET_Currency on SET_Currency.CurrencyID = poh.CurrencyID
) AP_PurchaseOrderHeader
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID= @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 {0}

data.name: Query_POStatus
data.value:
With InvoiceData As ( Select distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, PM.POHeaderID, PM.DocumentNumber,convert(varchar,PM.DocumentNumber) + '' +convert(varchar,PD.PODetailID) AS DocumentNumberTemp, PM.DocumentDate, PM.VendorID, PD.PODetailID, PD.Quantity as POQty, c.CustomerName AS supplier, itm.Description as ItemName, PD.ItemID, PD.ItemUOMID, uomPurchase.UOMName As PurchaseUOM, PD.UnitPrice ,Stock.DocumentNo AS GRNNo, convert(varchar,Stock.DocumentNo ) + '' +convert(varchar,Stock.TransactionDetailID ) AS GRNNotemp, Stock.TransactionDetailID as StockDetailID, Stock.TransactionQuantity as GRnQty, Stock.TransactionCost as GRNRate, Stock.DocumentDate as GRNDate ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,Stock.StockTransactionID,Stock.TransactionDetailID ,PM.CompanyID,PM.PeriodID,INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports,LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription as PoStatus ,isnull(PD.taxAmount,0) as taxAmount, isnull(PD.OtherTaxAmount,0) as OtherTaxAmount from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader PM inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail PD on PM.POHeaderID = PD.POHeaderID and PM.CompanyID = PD.CompanyID and PM.PeriodID = PD.PeriodID and PD.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = PM.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = PM.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = PM.PeriodID Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And {2} inner join INV_Item itm on PD.ItemID = itm.ItemID and itm.Status = 1 inner join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = itm.ItemTypeID inner join SET_UnitOfMeasure uomPurchase on uomPurchase.UOMID = PD.ItemUOMID and uomPurchase.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer c ON C.CustomerID = PM.VendorID AND C.PeriodID = PM.PeriodID and c.Status = 1 inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes bp ON bp.BusinessPartnerID = c.CustomerID --AND bp.CompanyID = c.CompanyID AND bp.PeriodID = c.PeriodID and PM.PeriodID = PD.PeriodID Left Join LookupDetail ON PM.StatusCode = LookupDetail.LookupDetailID And LookupDetail.LookupHeaderID = 5 Left Join ( Select StockHeader.DocumentNo, StockDetail.TransactionDetailID, StockDetail.TransactionQuantity, StockDetail.TransactionCost, StockHeader.DocumentDate, StockDetail.SourceHeaderID, StockDetail.SourceLineID, StockDetail.CompanyID, StockDetail.PeriodID, StockDetail.StockTransactionID ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,StockDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID,SourceCode, StockHeader.StatusCode,StockHeader.DepartmentID From INV_StockTransactionDetail As StockDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader As StockHeader on StockHeader.StockTransactionID = StockDetail.StockTransactionID and StockHeader.CompanyID = StockDetail.CompanyID and StockHeader.PeriodID = StockDetail.PeriodID and StockHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 and ISNULL(SET_DocumentType.IsHide, 0) = 0 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive'
Where StockDetail.Status = 1 And StockDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And (StockDetail.ItemID = @ItemID Or @ItemID IS NULL) And (StockHeader.BusinessPartnerID = @VendorID Or @VendorID IS NULL) ) As Stock On Pd.POHeaderID = Stock.SourceHeaderID and PD.PODetailID = Stock.SourceLineID and PM.CompanyID = Stock.CompanyID and PM.PeriodID = Stock.PeriodID and stock.SourceDocumentTypeID = PM.TypeCode and stock.SourceCode = PM.DocumentNumber
--left join ( Select invHead.InvoiceID,InvoiceDetailID,StockHeaderID,StockDetailID,invHead.InvoiceNumber, invHead.InvoiceDate, invdet.QuantityInvoiced, invdet.UnitPrice --,invHead.CompanyID,invHead.PeriodID,ItemID -- from AR_InvoiceDetail invdet --inner join AR_InvoiceHeader invHead on invHead.CompanyID = invdet.CompanyID -- And invHead.PeriodID = invdet.PeriodID -- And invHead.InvoiceID = invdet.InvoiceHeaderID -- And invHead.Status = 1 --) Invoice on Invoice.StockHeaderID = Stock.StockTransactionID and Invoice.StockDetailID = Stock.TransactionDetailID --and Invoice.CompanyID = Stock.CompanyID --And Invoice.PeriodID = Stock.PeriodID
--left join AR_InvoiceDetail invdet on invdet.CompanyID = Stock.CompanyID --And invdet.PeriodID = Stock.PeriodID -- And invdet.StockHeaderID = Stock.StockTransactionID --And invdet.StockDetailID = Stock.TransactionDetailID --And invdet.Status = 1
-- left join AR_InvoiceHeader invHead on invHead.CompanyID = invdet.CompanyID -- And invHead.PeriodID = invdet.PeriodID -- And invHead.InvoiceID = invdet.InvoiceHeaderID -- And invHead.Status = 1
--left join AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail paydet on paydet.CompanyID = Invoice.CompanyID --And paydet.PeriodID = Invoice.PeriodID -- And paydet.InvoiceHeaderID = Invoice.InvoiceID ----And paydet.InvoiceDetailID = invdet.InvoiceDetailID --And paydet.Status = 1
-- left join AP_PaymentHeader payHead on payHead.CompanyID = paydet.CompanyID -- And payHead.PeriodID = paydet.PeriodID -- And payHead.PaymentID = paydet.PaymentHeaderID --And payHead.Status = 1
--left join SET_DocumentType payType ON payHead.CompanyID = payType.CompanyID And payHead.PeriodID = payType.PeriodID -- And payHead.DocumentTypeID = payType.DocumentTypeID and payType.Status = 1 and ISNULL(payType.IsHide, 0) = 0
-- left join AP_PaymentHeader payHead_invoice on payHead_invoice.CompanyID = PM.CompanyID -- And payHead_invoice.PeriodID = PM.PeriodID -- And payHead_invoice.SourceheaderID = PM.POHeaderID --And payHead_invoice.Status = 1 --and payHead_invoice.vendorID = PM.VendorID
--left join SET_DocumentType payType_Invoice ON payHead_invoice.CompanyID = payType_Invoice.CompanyID --And payHead_invoice.PeriodID = payType_Invoice.PeriodID -- And payHead_invoice.DocumentTypeID = payType_Invoice.DocumentTypeID
Where PM.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PM.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND PM.Status = 1 AND (PM.TypeCode = @DocumentTypeID OR @DocumentTypeID is null) AND (PD.CategoryID = @CategoryID OR @CategoryID is null) AND ISNULL(SET_DocumentType.IsHide, 0) = 0 AND (PD.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID is null) AND (PM.VendorID = @VendorID OR @VendorID is null) AND PM.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND (stock.StatusCode = 1 or stock.StatusCode is null) {0}
--order by PM.POHeaderID )
Select InvoiceData.*,invHead.InvoiceNumber,convert(varchar,invHead.InvoiceNumber) + '' +convert(varchar,invdet.InvoiceDetailID) as InvoiceNumberTemp, invHead.InvoiceDate, invdet.QuantityInvoiced,InvoiceID ,payType.DocumentType as PaymentType,paydet.Amount as PayAmount, invdet.InvoiceDetailID ,payHead.DocumentNo as PayDocNo,convert(varchar,payHead.DocumentNo) + '' +convert(varchar,paydet.PaymentInvoicesID) as PayDocNotemp,invHead.InvoiceID,invdet.UnitPrice as InvRate ,payHead.DocumentDate as PayDate, paydet.PaymentInvoicesID --Adance Payment ,payType_Invoice.DocumentType as AdvanceType ,payHead_invoice.DocumentNo as AdvanceDocNO ,payHead_invoice.Amount as AdvanceAmount ,payHead_invoice.DocumentDate as AdvanceDate, invHead.VendorReferenceNumber from InvoiceData
left join AR_InvoiceDetail invdet on invdet.CompanyID = InvoiceData.CompanyID And invdet.PeriodID = InvoiceData.PeriodID And invdet.StockHeaderID = InvoiceData.StockTransactionID And invdet.StockDetailID = InvoiceData.TransactionDetailID And invdet.Status = 1
left join AR_InvoiceHeader invHead on invHead.CompanyID = invdet.CompanyID And invHead.PeriodID = invdet.PeriodID And invHead.InvoiceID = invdet.InvoiceHeaderID And invHead.Status = 1
left join AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail paydet on paydet.CompanyID = InvoiceData.CompanyID And paydet.PeriodID = InvoiceData.PeriodID And paydet.InvoiceHeaderID = invHead.InvoiceID --And paydet.InvoiceDetailID = invdet.InvoiceDetailID And paydet.Status = 1 and paydet.PaymentHeaderID in (select PaymentHeaderID from Ap_PaymentBanksDetail where Ap_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = paydet.CompanyID and Ap_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = paydet.PeriodID and Ap_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = paydet.PaymentHeaderID and Ap_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 )
left join AP_PaymentHeader payHead on payHead.CompanyID = paydet.CompanyID And payHead.PeriodID = paydet.PeriodID And payHead.PaymentID = paydet.PaymentHeaderID And payHead.Status = 1 and payHead.PaymentID in (select PaymentHeaderID from Ap_PaymentBanksDetail where Ap_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = payHead.CompanyID and Ap_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = payHead.PeriodID and Ap_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = payHead.PaymentID and Ap_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 )
left join SET_DocumentType payType ON payHead.CompanyID = payType.CompanyID And payHead.PeriodID = payType.PeriodID And payHead.DocumentTypeID = payType.DocumentTypeID and payType.Status = 1 and ISNULL(payType.IsHide, 0) = 0
left join AP_PaymentHeader payHead_invoice on payHead_invoice.CompanyID = InvoiceData.CompanyID And payHead_invoice.PeriodID = InvoiceData.PeriodID And payHead_invoice.SourceheaderID = InvoiceData.POHeaderID And payHead_invoice.Status = 1 and payHead_invoice.vendorID = InvoiceData.VendorID
left join SET_DocumentType payType_Invoice ON payHead_invoice.CompanyID = payType_Invoice.CompanyID And payHead_invoice.PeriodID = payType_Invoice.PeriodID And payHead_invoice.DocumentTypeID = payType_Invoice.DocumentTypeID
where isnull(invHead.IsReversed,0) <> 1 and invHead.ReversalID is null -- and isnull(invHead.IsReversed,0) <> 1 and invHead.ReversalID is null
order by POHeaderID, PODetailID,GRNNo asc

data.name: Query_SelectAll_ForApproveDetailForConnect
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate, ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AcceptanceDueDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedByvalue, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail pod ON pod.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 AND pod.Status = 1 AND pod.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND pod.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.Customerid = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT poh.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh WHERE poh.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND poh.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND poh.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT poh.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh WHERE poh.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND poh.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND poh.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = @POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = @DocumentTypeID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = @DocumentNo

data.name: Query_getAmountQuantity
data.value: Select IsNull(Sum(Quantity * UnitPrice), 0) As Amount, IsNull(Sum(IsNull(Quantity, 0)), 0) As TransactionQuantity From AP_SaleContractDetail Inner Join AP_SaleContractHeader ON AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID = AP_SaleContractDetail.SaleContractID AND AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractDetail.CompanyID AND AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractDetail.PeriodID AND AP_SaleContractHeader.Status = 1 Where AP_SaleContractDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AP_SaleContractDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_SaleContractDetail.Status = 1 And AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID = @ItemID

data.name: Query_ImportDocumentLookUp_WeightAssessmentForConnect
data.value:
Select Distinct * from ( SELECT AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AcceptanceDueDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AcceptanceRequiredFlag, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AmountLimit, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ApprovalRequiredFlag, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ApprovedDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ApprovedFlag, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AuthorizationStatusCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BillToLocationID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BlanketTotalAmount, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CancelFlag, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ClosedCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ClosedDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Comments, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CurrencyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.EndDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FOBCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FreightTermsCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FromHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FromTypeCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FrozenFlag, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.MinReleaseAmount, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.NoteToReceiver, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.NoteToVendor, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PrintCount, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PrintedDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.QuoteType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Rate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RateType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ReplyDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ReplyMethod, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RevisedDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RevisionNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RFQClosedDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipToLocationID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipViaCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StartDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TermsID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TotalAmount, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.UserHoldFlag, isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorQuoteNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreatedBy, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreatedByValue, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.UpdatedBy, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.UpdateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.UpdatedByValue, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.IsActive, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate, SET_Location.LocationName, SET_Term.Description AS 'TermDescription', SET_Currency.CurrencyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS POTypeName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PODueDate ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber as BLNO,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.NoofContainers as NoOfContainers ,AP_SaleContractHeader.ContractNo FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderDetail ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipToLocationID INNER JOIN AP_SaleContractHeader ON AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SaleContractID LEFT JOIN SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TermsID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN (Select SourceCode,SourceDocumentTypeID,SourceHeaderID,SourceLineID,INV_StocktransactionHeader.CompanyID,INV_StocktransactionHeader.PeriodID,Sum(TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity from INV_StocktransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StocktransactionHeader ON INV_StocktransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StocktransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StocktransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StocktransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StocktransactionHeader.PeriodID
Where INV_StocktransactionDetail.Status=1 group by SourceCode,SourceDocumentTypeID,SourceHeaderID,SourceLineID,INV_StocktransactionHeader.CompanyID,INV_StocktransactionHeader.PeriodID ) as StockTransaction ON StockTransaction.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID AND StockTransaction.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID AND StockTransaction.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID AND StockTransaction.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID AND StockTransaction.SourceDocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND StockTransaction.SourceCode = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber Left Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID {0} WHERE (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = @StatusCode OR @StatusCode IS NULL) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = @SupplierID OR @SupplierID IS NULL) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = @POHeaderID OR @POHeaderID IS NULL) AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity > ISNULL(StockTransaction.TransactionQuantity,0) {1} AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 And IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.IsInvoiceAdjusted, 0) = 0 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode in (Select DocumenttypeID from SET_DocumentType where DocumentType like '%Import%doc%') ) as fintab

data.name: Query_ImportDocument_ImportReport
data.value:
SELECT AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate, ToLocation.LocationName as ToLocation, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as DocumentNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipmentDate, AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentNumber as ContractNo, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Rate as ConversionRate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RateDate as CurrencyRateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.typeCode as DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.NoofContainers, (CASE WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipViaCode=1 then 'ByAir' WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipViaCode=2 then 'ByRoad' WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipViaCode=3 then 'BySea' else '' end ) ShipmentMode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Comments, (CASE WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FOBCode = 1 then 'Delivered' WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FOBCode = 2 then 'ExMill' else '' end ) PaymentType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AmountIndollar, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.BankName,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.AccountNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ETADate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ETDDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ContainerNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ServiceCharges as RetirementSwiftServicesCharges, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TotalAmount, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.SerialNo, SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID, Item.Description as ItemDescription, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, Abs(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity) AS TransactionQuantity, isnull(case when AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice=0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice end,0) TransactionCost, ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.NetAmount,0) as NetAmount, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemUOMID as TransactionUOMID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ContainerNo as DetContainerNo, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ContainerSize,INV_StockTransactionDetail.QuantityAdjusted, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CBM, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.SealNo,
( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) + Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) As CurrentStock, ( Select Sum(TransactionQuantity) From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' Where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 AND Cast(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CreateDate as Date) Between Cast(DateAdd(yy, -1, GetDate())as Date) AND CAST(GetDate() as Date) ) LastConsumption, ( Select top 1 UnitPrice as LastPrice from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate desc ) as LastPurchasePrice, isnull(case when AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice=0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice end,0) as CustomAmount, (Abs(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity)*AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice) as GrossAmountINDollar
FROM AP_PurchaseOrderDetail INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader oN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID --INV_Item.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AND INV_Item.Status = 1 --AND Item.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID left JOIN INV_ItemDetails ON INV_ItemDetails.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID AND INV_ItemDetails.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = Item.ItemCatalogGroupID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Contractor ON Contractor.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ContractorID AND Contractor.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND Contractor.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND Contractor.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID and Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID LEFT join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 LEFT join SET_Location as ToLocation on ToLocation.LocationID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipToLocationID Left JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND SET_Rack.Status=1 left join INV_Item EndProduct on EndProduct.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FinishingItemID left join SET_ItemCatalog EndCatalog on EndCatalog.ItemCatalogID = EndProduct.ItemCatalogGroupID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category EndCategory ON EndProduct.ItemTypeID = EndCategory.CategoryID and EndProduct.CompanyID = EndCategory.CompanyID Left JOIN Fabrics_PackType On Fabrics_PackType.PackTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PackTypeID AND Fabrics_PackType.Status=1 Left Join SET_UnitofMeasure uom On uom.UOMID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.SecondaryUOMID And uom.Status = 1 Left JOIN AP_SaleContractHeader ON AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SaleContractID And AP_SaleContractHeader.Status = 1
Left Join FA_LetterOfCreditHeader on FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.SaleContractID = AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID AND FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID AND FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID AND FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Status = 1
WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Import%' {0}
Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber asc

data.name: Query_POGRNBalanceReport_New
data.value:
select CustomerName, case when max(GLType) = 'Debit' then abs(sum(GLBalance)) * -1 else abs(sum(GLBalance)) end as GLBalance,max(GLType) as GLType,sum(POBalance) as POBalance ,sum(GRNBalance) as GRNBalance from (
select tab.CustomerName ,(sum(debit) - sum(credit)) as GLBalance, case when (sum(debit) - sum(credit)) < 0 then 'Credit' else 'Debit' end as GLType,0 as POBalance,0 as GRNBalance from (
---------- Sales Invoice Header ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Description As Comments, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit'
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID IN @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalID is null and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0 --and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between null and null) OR (null is null) OR (null is null)) AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @Todate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Description, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
Union All ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID IN @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null --and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between null and null) OR (null is null) OR (null is null)) AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @Todate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
union all ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO From Sal_InvoiceHeader
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode
inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode Where Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID IN @CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = 1 And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) < @Todate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.DocumentTypeID,FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
union all ---------- Purchase Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode as CustomerAccountCode, Case When AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO From AR_InvoiceHeader
Inner Join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail On AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode
inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID IN @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = 1 And IsNull(AR_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) < @Todate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.DocumentTypeID,FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO Union All ---------- Sales Receipt Customer Detail ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select DISTINCT GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID,STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and PBD.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and PBD.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo, '' as InvoiceNumber ,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail On AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status=1 --Left Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status= 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID IN @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null --and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between null and null) OR (null is null) OR (null is null)) AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @Todate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo, FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO union all ---------- Sales Receipt Customer Detail - Opening ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate, CreateDate,CompanyID,FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select DISTINCT AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail On AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID

AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and PBD.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo ,'' as InvoiceNumber ,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO FROM AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1

= GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = ( SELECT max(DefaultAccountCode) FROM SET_DocumentType WHERE DocumentType like 'Advance Against SO%' AND CompanyID IN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = ---------- Import Document ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, Fintab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode As CodeCombinationID, FinTab.CodeDescription ,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, '' as PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,'' AS InstrumentNo ,'' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader .CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader .PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 inner JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
