WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID IN @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @Todate
--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between null and null) OR (null is null) OR (null is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null Or null is null) and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is not null and INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID is not null and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
UNION ALL ----Sales Invoice Return SELECT distinct SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate AS DocumentDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, ISNULL(SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, 0) as DocumentNo, 0 as Debit , SUM(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount) as Credit, '' AS InstrumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.Narration AS Comments, GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID as CodeCombinationID , GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO FROM SET_DocumentType Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SET_DocumentType.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID =SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID
left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Local Sale Debtor - Sugar' left join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID WHERE SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID IN @CompanyID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = 1 AND convert(date,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate) < @Todate and SAL_ReverseHeader.StatusCode = 1
and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.ContactNumber , AR_SET_Customer.ContactPerson , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate,SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo ,SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID ,GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description,GL_TransactionHeader.Narration )as tab Left Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_CustomerID = tab.CustomerID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID IN @CompanyID
group by tab.CustomerName
union all
select CustomerName, 0 as GLBalance,'' as GLType,sum((Quantity - RcvQty)*UnitPrice) as POBalance,0 as GRNBalance from ( SELECT AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TotalAmount, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, INV_Item.Description, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity, isnull( ( Select abs(SUM(isnull(sd.TransactionQuantity,0))) from INV_StockTransactionDetail sd where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = sd.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = sd.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = sd.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID AND sd.Status = 1 and sd.SourceDocumentTypeID =SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID ), 0) as RcvQty, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice FROM AP_PurchaseOrderDetail INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 --AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID AND LEFT OUTER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemUOMID = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom .CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID --and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between @fromDate and @Todate and isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ClosedCode,0) <> 1 and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
) as TAB Where TAB.RcvQty < TAB.Quantity group by CustomerName
union all
-- GRN balance
select Supplier as CustomerName,0 as GLBalance,'' as GLType,0 as POBalance,sum(GRN_Amount) as GRNBalance from (
select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier, '(' + INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode + ') ' + INV_Item.Description as Item, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as GRN_No, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity as PO_Quantity, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity) as GRN_Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as ApprovedGRN_Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity as RejectedGRN_Quantity, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as RemainingQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as Rate, round(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 1) as PO_Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount as GRN_Amount, 0 as BalanceAmount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0 as QuantityInvoiced,0 as AmountPaid, CONVERT(varchar(20), AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 105) as InvoiceDate, 0 as InvoiceNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID ANd INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.status = 1 INNER join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 inner join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1 inner join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].MenuID LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 LEFT Join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status =1
left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
where INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @fromDate and @Todate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- (only approved GRN appeared) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 --and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ClosedCode > 2 --(coz Inprocess Invoice not showing) and [ApplicationMenu].MenuPath like '%/Stock_frm.aspx'
and (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , '(' + INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode + ') ' + INV_Item.Description , AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo , AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity , Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity) , INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity , AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost , round(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 1) , INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount , round((AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) - INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, 3), INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, CONVERT(varchar(20), AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 105) , AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID,AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID,AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType ,AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID,AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID
having isnull(( select sum(indtl.QuantityInvoiced) from AR_InvoiceHeader invHdr inner join AR_InvoiceDetail indtl on indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = invHdr.InvoiceID and indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = invHdr.InvoiceID and indtl.CompanyID = invHdr.CompanyID and indtl.PeriodID = invHdr.PeriodID and indtl.Status = 1 where indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and indtl.InvoiceDetailID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and indtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and indtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID ),0 ) <> INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity
)tab group by Supplier
)as fintab
group by CustomerName
